scenarios.milestone: Cash in chips / run of bad luck / ending

redirect_r1a1.result: Exit hotspot Y=0 -> 'CASH IN YOUR CHIPS? YES NO'; A on YES -> EndingTally ($C72B): rating screen (flashing message), ending music $83, scrolling desert picture (screens $16/$17), then MainInit (legal screen). All six ratings visited by patching ChipCounts $A7-$AB / ChipOverflow $077E before entry: $0 -> bus (broke path), $1000 natural -> taxi ($11), 60x$100 -> green car ($12), 200x$100 -> orange sedan ($13), overflow 3 -> limousine ($14), 255x$100+overflow 10 -> red sports car ($15). Broke path: zero chips, enter slot Y=15 -> SlotTypeB_Round sees PlayerIsBroke -> ReturnFromGame -> GameOverBroke ('I'M SORRY YOU HAD A RUN OF BAD LUCK. COME AGAIN SOON.') -> A -> EndingTally message $10 (bus). Cash status screen: START on floor ('TOTAL EARNINGS $1000').
